description: This file defines a class `Image_Graph_Marker_Cross` which is a specialization of `Image_Graph_Marker`. It provides functionality to draw a cross-shaped data marker on a graphical canvas, including drawing lines and polygons with configurable thickness and size. The class is part of a larger Image Graph rendering utility, and references a parent class for core marker behaviors.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Cross
classes.description: A data marker class representing a cross shape, capable of drawing itself on a canvas, with configurable size and thickness.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the cross marker on the canvas at specified coordinates with optional data values.
